note: Fauna Sinica records only the soldier, not the alate or the worker; the original description is Li, 1987, Entomotaxonomia 9(3): 232. The locality is given as Hainan (Nada).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier: head yellow, frons yellow-brown, mandibles blackish brown; head rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly straight; the sides of the middle of the frons slightly raised into a V, with a slight shallow concavity in the middle, the ridges on both sides of the antennal sockets distinctly raised; left mandible with 4 marginal teeth (teeth 1 and 2 largest, tooth 3 smaller, tooth 4 smallest and sometimes not very distinct), right mandible with 2 distinct marginal teeth, tooth 3 reduced and indistinct; antennae 12—14-segmented. Head length to the base of the mandibles 1.73—2.32 mm, head width 1.20—1.38 mm, left mandible length 1.05—1.20 mm, the mandibles being among the stouter in the genus.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, frons yellow-brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellow, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head with very few hairs, the anterior margin of the labrum with a few long hairs, the periphery of the pronotum with sparse short and long hairs. Head rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly straight, the sides of the middle of the frons slightly raised into a V with a slight shallow concavity in the middle, the ridges on both sides of the antennal sockets distinctly raised, the Y-shaped suture distinct, the compound eye spot oval and rather conspicuous; labrum semicircular, wider than long; mandibles stout, the apex slightly curved, left mandible with 4 marginal teeth, teeth 1 and 2 largest, tooth 3 smaller, tooth 4 smallest and sometimes not very distinct, right mandible with 2 distinct marginal teeth, tooth 3 reduced and indistinct; antennae 12—14-segmented, in the 12-segmented condition segments 2, 3 and 4 nearly equal, in the 13—14-segmented condition segment 3 shorter and smaller; postmentum broad anteriorly and narrow posteriorly, its greatest width more than 2 times its least width. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the anterior margin broadly and shallowly concave, the posterior margin slightly arcuate and rounded, with a slight median incision that is very inconspicuous. Measurements (range/mean): head length to the base of the mandibles 1.73—2.32/2.07 mm; head width 1.20—1.38/1.28 mm; head height 1.08—1.25/1.15 mm; left mandible length 1.05—1.20/1.10 mm; postmentum length 1.27—1.61/1.45 mm; postmentum greatest width 0.407—0.50/0.46 mm; postmentum least width 0.19—0.20/0.198 mm; pronotal length 0.425—0.60/0.52 mm; pronotal width 1.08—1.22/1.17 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Host: the rubber tree Hevea brasiliensis (H.B.K.) Muell. Arg.; the distribution is recorded only from Hainan (Nada).
